doc.title: Nancy Wilson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Pop music today
summary: She says current pop is not music but credits Ne-Yo and will.i.am.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: Is jazz healthy? Young players, rock and the future

blocks.x: Do you think that the music has changed, for better or for worse?

Well, you can’t put music in there at all. Really, it’s not music. I’m sorry. Come on. I’m just dealing with the reality of my age and what not. What is going on today obviously does not appeal to someone my age. I’m trying to be nice about it. I do watch every now and then, and I see certain things, but none of it registers. It doesn’t stick with me. I mentioned Beyoncé and her particular version of a song called Listen, because it reached my heart. It touched me. But the rest of the stuff is outrageous outfits. Oh, no, no. Pop music today . . .
No. Will.i.am writes some melodies every now and then, and so does Ne-Yo. And you didn’t even know I knew who they were, did you?
See there. Ne-Yo, he writes a melody. He writes a story.
